title: Publication of Sefer Łuków by former residents in Israel and the United States
summary: A source-critical article documenting the 1968 Tel Aviv publication of the Łuków memorial book, its editor B. Heller, and the cooperation or parallel activity of Łuków survivor organizations in Israel and the United States.

editorialConnections.recordTitle: Organization of Łuków Jews in Israel
Łuków Landsmanschaft in the United States

editorialContent: The JewishGen translation identifies B. Heller as editor of Sefer Łuków, published in Tel Aviv in 1968. It describes the volume as the work of former residents of Łuków in Israel and the United States and includes a separate chapter on the Łuków landsmanshaftn in the United States. The available evidence supports a transnational commemorative network, but does not yet establish the officers, legal identity, or exact relationship among the similarly named Israeli organizations.
